name: Ridgecrest to Paso Robles (owner's route, 2026-10-04)
purpose: Inyokern, CA-14 south to Mojave, CA-58 over Tehachapi Pass to Bakersfield, I-5 north to exit 278, CA-46 west through Cholame and Shandon to Paso Robles, then Nacimiento Lake Drive and Chimney Rock Road to Adelaide. Phases P1 to P7 in BUDGET.md.

routes.description: CA-58 from Mojave over Tehachapi Pass, through Keene and Caliente country, down to Bakersfield.
I-5 north from the CA-58 junction near Buttonwillow to exit 278 at Lost Hills.
CA-46 west from Lost Hills past Cholame and Shandon to Paso Robles.
Nacimiento Lake Drive and Chimney Rock Road from Paso Robles to Adelaide.

counties.name: San Luis Obispo County
counties.focus: The route crosses the county's north end: CA-46 from the Kern line past Cholame, the San Andreas Fault and Shandon, then Paso Robles and the hills west to Adelaide and Lake Nacimiento. Most cards about that side; a handful county-wide (how the county formed, its size, government, the missions, the coast a driver is heading toward).

leadsToResearch: Cholame and James Dean's 1955 crash at the CA-46 and CA-41 junction; the memorial at Cholame
The San Andreas Fault crossing near Cholame; Parkfield
Paso Robles: the hot springs and the 1886 hotel, the 2003 San Simeon earthquake, the wine district
The Santa Lucia Range; Lake Nacimiento; Adelaide
note: Leads are things to research, not facts. Every card fact needs its own sources.
